- **Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt (Bugwood_11)**: Some collapsed stems, green tomatoes still on upper portions.
- **Southern_Blight (Bugwood_32)**: Dried brown stems, still mostly upright — less similar.
- All leaf disease references (Early_Blight, Bacterial_Speck, TSWV, etc.) show leaf lesions, not whole-plant collapse.

The test image shows a plant that has completely fallen over — consistent with rapid vascular wilt causing stem collapse, on the same black plastic mulch setup as the Southern_Bacterial_Wilt reference. The still-green leaves indicate rapid collapse rather than gradual die-off.
